# rustinion_device_package_cleanup (Resource)

Overrides package cleanup for one device: "on", "off" or "inherit" (the group's rustinion_group_package_cleanup). The machine owner's local --no-package-cleanup still wins; enabled and source show the effective result. Destroying this resource sets the device back to inherit.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The device.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) "on", "off" or "inherit". Default inherit.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether cleanup is effectively on for the device.
- `id` (String) Same as device_id.
- `source` (String) Where the effective value comes from: device_local_opt_out, device_setting or group_policy.
